usageNotes: Use this endpoint to enumerate all SDN prefix lists defined in the cluster — these are named IP prefix sets used by BGP-based SDN configurations (e.g., EVPN zones). Without the 'verbose' flag only IDs are returned, making it useful for quick existence checks before referencing a prefix list in a zone or route-map. Requires 'SDN.Audit' or 'SDN.Allocate' permission on the relevant SDN objects; users without either permission receive an empty list rather than an error.

examples.summary: List all prefix lists with full details, showing any pending (uncommitted) changes

tips: Omitting 'verbose' (or setting it to false) returns only IDs — sufficient for checking membership before a create/update call.
Use 'pending: true' after editing SDN config to see staged changes before running 'apply' (which pushes them to the running config).
Use 'running: true' to see what is actually active in the data plane, which may differ from stored config if an apply has not yet been performed.
Prefix lists only appear if SDN is enabled on the cluster and at least one EVPN or BGP-capable zone is configured.
